record.paper_title: Vector bundles on curves and generalized theta functions: recent results and open problems
record.context_brief: Embedding property of the rank-2 theta map
record.original_question: Let X be a non-hyperelliptic compact Riemann surface of genus g ≥ 3. For rank 2 bundles with trivial determinant, is the theta map θ: SU_X(2) → |2Θ| always an embedding?

evidence.quote: c) For g ≥ 3 , C not hyperelliptic, θ is of degree one onto its image [B 1]. Moreover if g(C) = 3 or if C is generic, θ is an embedding
Q 4. – Is θ always an embedding for C non hyperelliptic?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth, complex, non-hyperelliptic compact Riemann surface (equivalently, smooth projective curve) of genus $g \ge 3$. Let $SU_X(2)$ denote the moduli space of S-equivalence classes of semistable rank-$2$ holomorphic vector bundles on $X$ with trivial determinant. Let $\Theta \subset \mathrm{Pic}^{g-1}(X)$ denote the canonical theta divisor consisting of line bundles of degree $g-1$ admitting a nonzero global section, and let $|2\Theta|$ be the linear system of divisors on $\mathrm{Pic}^{g-1}(X)$ algebraically equivalent to $2\Theta$. There is a natural morphism (the rank-$2$ theta map)
$$\theta : SU_X(2) \longrightarrow |2\Theta|, \qquad E \longmapsto \Theta_E := \{L \in \mathrm{Pic}^{g-1}(X) : h^0(X, E \otimes L) > 0\},$$
which is known to be a finite morphism of degree one onto its image when $X$ is non-hyperelliptic.

Question: Is $\theta$ a closed embedding for every non-hyperelliptic smooth projective curve $X$ of genus $g \ge 3$?
artifact.category_tag: Moduli of vector bundles and theta maps
artifact.status_search_result: The theta map $\theta: SU_X(2) \to |2\Theta|$ is known to be injective with injective differential at smooth points for every non-hyperelliptic curve (Brivio–Verra), and is known to be a closed embedding for $g=3$ and for generic curves of any genus $\ge 3$. However, no source found establishes that $\theta$ is an embedding for every non-hyperelliptic curve of genus $\ge 3$; the question continues to be cited as open in subsequent literature on generalized theta functions.

status_evidence.title: The theta divisor of SU_C(2,2d)^s is very ample if C is not hyperelliptic (Brivio–Verra)
status_evidence.snippet: The theta divisor of SU_C(2,2d)^s is very ample if C is not hyperelliptic.
status_evidence.claim: Embedding-type results known on the stable locus, but not phrased as a complete affirmative answer for all of SU_X(2).

status_evidence.title: Tangent cones to generalised theta divisors and generic injectivity of the theta map (Hitching–Hoff)
status_evidence.snippet: The theta map SU_C(r) --> |rΘ| is generically injective for large values of g, recovering and sharpening Brivio–Verra.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to address only generic injectivity rather than settling the embedding question for all non-hyperelliptic curves.

status_evidence.title: Classical theta functions and their generalization (Beauville lecture notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of θ for SU_X(2) and the question whether it is always an embedding for non-hyperelliptic X.
status_evidence.claim: The embedding question for arbitrary non-hyperelliptic curves is still discussed as a question in survey literature.
